title: Сашу выгнали из квартиры  (Sasha Gets Evicted from Her Apartment)

segments.t: At the bar counter, Sasha confesses to Max that her landlady kicked her out of the apartment and demanded a huge sum for the water damage that she cannot afford. Before Max can figure out how to help her, Nastya grabs Kostya by the hand and drags him away.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'Hey, how are things going?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'regards' before landing on 'things'.
'Not bad.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'nothing'. Kostya answers right away.
'My landlady kicked me out of the apartment.' The meaning hinges on 'me' working together with 'kicked out' in spoken Russian.
'What do you mean she kicked you out?' Nastya anchors the line on 'how', while 'kicked out' completes the thought.
'Wait, did you two really mop the floors?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'to wash'. Nastya answers right away.
'And what are you going to do now?' Notice how Russian puts 'will you' and 'what is one to do' together in a short, direct phrase where word endings show how the ideas connect.
'I do not know, she said either...' Notice how Russian expresses 'not' and 'or' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I do not have that kind of money.' Notice how Russian expresses 'by' and 'there is no' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'I really do not know.' In Russian, the idea of 'yes' flows naturally into 'know' without extra filler words.
'It is fine, I will think of something.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'yes' and finishing on 'will come up with'.
'Kostik, come with me.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'Kostik' and 'let's go' in a few short words. Nastya answers right away.
'Nastya, wait a second, are you serious?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Nastya' before landing on 'seriously'.
'Are you actually serious right now?' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'seriously' in a few short words. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
That wraps up this scene as sasha tells Max at the bar that her landlady evicted her over the flood damage, while Nastya pulls Kostya aside with an unexpected request. See you next time!
